title: Output pivotality
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\{\pm1\}$ be a Boolean function, let $b\in\{\pm1\}$, let $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and let $x\in\{-1,1\}^n$. Say that $i$ is output-pivotal for $f$ at $x$ with output $b$ when $f(x)=b$ and coordinate $i$ is pivotal for $f$ at $x$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function f on n-bit inputs with sign-valued output
input x in the n-dimensional Boolean cube
